hero.headline: Authentic Halal Indian Cuisine in Burlington
hero.subheadline: The vibrant flavors of North India, made with traditional recipes and fresh ingredients. 100% halal, served for dine-in, takeout and delivery.

about.headline: Welcome to Aroma Delight
about.description: Aroma Delight brings the vibrant, authentic flavors of North India to Burlington, MA. We cook with traditional recipes, aromatic spices and fresh ingredients to create a dining experience that transports you to the bustling streets and kitchens of India. Every dish on our menu is 100% halal. Whether you are a longtime lover of Indian food or trying it for the first time, our team is here to make every meal memorable.

highlights.title: 100% Halal
highlights.description: Every dish we serve is prepared with halal-certified ingredients, so the whole community can dine with confidence.

highlights.title: North Indian Roots
highlights.description: Our chefs cook the classics the traditional way — tandoori, rich curries, biryanis and fresh-baked naan straight from the clay oven.

highlights.title: Fresh Ingredients
highlights.description: We source quality spices and fresh produce so every plate arrives bursting with authentic flavor.

highlights.title: Dine-In, Takeout & Delivery
highlights.description: Enjoy Aroma Delight at our table in Burlington, grab it to go, or have it delivered to your door.

catering.headline: Catering Services
catering.description: Let Aroma Delight bring authentic halal Indian food to your next event. We cater weddings, corporate events, birthday parties and more, and we will work with you on a custom menu that fits your taste and budget. Tell us about your event and we will follow up with a quote.
catering.advanceNotice: At least 48 hours notice required for all catering orders

faq.question: Is your food halal?
faq.answer: Yes. Every dish at Aroma Delight is 100% halal. All of our meat is halal-certified.

faq.question: Do you offer vegetarian and vegan options?
faq.answer: Yes. We have an extensive vegetarian menu, a dedicated tofu section that is fully vegan, and many dishes that can be made vegan on request. Please note any dietary needs in the order instructions and our kitchen will do its best to accommodate.

faq.question: How do I order online?
faq.answer: Browse the menu on this page, add what you would like to your cart, then choose pickup or delivery at checkout. You can order for as soon as possible or schedule a time ahead. Payment is by card and is processed securely by Stripe.

faq.question: Do you offer delivery?
faq.answer: Yes. You can order delivery or pickup directly on this site, and we also take orders by phone at (781) 273-0111. Delivery is handled by our courier partner to addresses within about 10 miles of the restaurant, with a $20 minimum order. The delivery fee is quoted for your address before you pay.

faq.question: What are your hours?
faq.answer: We are open 7 days a week from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

faq.question: Where are you located?
faq.answer: Aroma Delight is at 184 Cambridge St, Burlington, MA 01803.

faq.question: Do you cater events?
faq.answer: Yes. We cater weddings, corporate events, birthday parties and more. Send us the details through our catering form or call us directly and we will put together a quote. At least 48 hours advance notice is required.
